facts.fact: The Internet Society's IXP Tracker, from PeeringDB data of August 2026, lists BDIXP in Bujumbura with 9 member ASNs, 26 Gbps of cumulative port capacity and no members joining or leaving in the previous 12 months.

The Internet Society's IXP Tracker lists Akamai Technologies (AS20940, 1 Gbps, peers at the route server) and Meta (AS63293, 10 Gbps) as members of BDIXP in Bujumbura, from PeeringDB data of August 2026.

The Internet Society's IXP Tracker shows BDIXP members registered abroad (3 in the United States, including Meta and two PCH ASNs, and 1 in the Netherlands, Akamai) beside 5 registered in Burundi, from PeeringDB data of August 2026.
